steps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context
2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A is expired; refresh R expires at controlled time T+600 seconds
4. And the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is visible
5. And the relogin response remains pending
6. When User A clicks the button labelled "Extend" inside the dialog named "Your session has been expired"
